jobs_results.title: Front-end Angular Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a talented Frontend Developer experienced in Angular to join our team in Barcelona. You will be working with a skilled and talented team developing with the latest technologies and always with best practices.

As a Frontend developer you will be working within a cross-functional team to build Innofis products and platform, reinforcing our omnichannel banking product and helping build from the ground our clients products.

A few words from Oriol, our Head of Software Architecture:
“Working at CREALOGIX is challenging for many reasons. Our focus is becoming the #1 global provider of Digital Banking Platforms, it means that we need to transform ourselves into a Product and People Company. Here’s where our Cross Teams take relevance and therefore we need to grow, Cross Teams are formed around specific technical interests like Frontend, Backend, Mobile and DevOps with the common goal of defining a single CODE base for Delivery Teams.

We need people who wants to lead the... change with us, who doesn’t want to reinvent the wheel but leverage on experience, standards and well-known best practices. If you are interested Let’s talk! ”

Soft skills:
• Passionate about web technologies
• Collaborate with other teams to ensure design and integration
• Develop in a test-oriented and fast paced environment
• Capable of creating strategies to implement products in the best roadmap for balance between technical and business objectives.
• Identify and communicate risks before implement the solution
• Resolve defects during QA testing and in post-release patches

Technical requirements:
• Experienced in modern front end framework (Angular5+, bonus points for Angular 9 or 10)
• Preferred development experience with Typescript.
• Significant experience with CSS preprocessors (LESS/Sass)
• Ability to write high-performance, reusable code for UI components.
• In depth experience with modern responsive web design.
• Knowledge of native DOM and Event API’s
• Broad knowledge of different components and tools available in the market and pros and cons of them
• Knowledgeable with Git

Would be a plus … Any kind of knowledge or experience with:
• Linux, *nix
• NodeJS experience
• Has worked in financial services
• Experience with Webpack
• Experience with Ionic Framework
• Experience with web site/app security
• Reactive programming
• Native and Hybrid programming

Why work with us?
• Great location: our offices are in one of the best area for Barcelona businesses
• Remote work: 2 days per week
• Solid company working in the growing sector of eBanking and Fintech
• Casual dress code
• All Fridays and August: intensive schedule
• Great work environment
• Free coffee and eco fruit every week
• Flexible working hours
• International and dynamic environment
• Joining a solid company in a market of continuous growth which invest in the most advanced technologies

Innofis|CREALOGIX is a self-financed and privately held company helping companies to achieve sustainable competitive advantages by means of an efficient, innovative use of IT. Innovation as a key component for sustainable growth.

Innofis was born in a social, global world, with international vision, serving customers all around the globe.Today, Innofis is highly-focused in providing customer centric solutions to financial institutions in a digital world.

Our digital omnichannel platform, value-added modules and data analytics solutions will help Banks to boost its digital strategy in a robust, personalized, integrated and time-to-market manner.

That’s our daily challenge.

Why INNOFIS – CREALOGIX

Since January 2018 INNOFIS with more than 130 very skilled employees has become a member of the CREALOGIX-Group. Have you ever thought about what makes you laugh? Humorous friends or even challenging activities? INNOFIS laughs a lot – whether it’s a joke or two, working together on tricky tasks and achieving projects.

We Crealogues work in a dynamic and demanding environment with many challenges to master. If you are not losing your smile in a dynamic environment and have stamina and endurance, then you can expect personal responsibility, varied tasks and an open culture, casual dress code, English lessons and much more.

About the CREALOGIX-Group:

Our history began in 1996 in Switzerland with a few innovative minds and today we employ about 570 people at various locations worldwide, including Switzerland, Germany, England, Austria, Singapore and, most recently, Spain. The CREALOGIX Group is a globally active, independent Swiss software house and is one of the market leaders in digital banking as a FinTech Top 100 company.

CREALOGIX develops and implements:
• Innovative FinTech solutions for the digital bank of tomorrow,
• Smart solutions for home and office for everything that makes administration, payment transactions and e-banking
• Didactic and technical solutions for web-based learning in companies, administrations and educational institutions

Crealogix awards
• First place at the Private Banking & Wealth Management Germany Awards
• Best of Show at Finovate Europe
• Asian Private Banking Technology Award
• Best digital channels banking system provider at The Banking Technology Awards
• Best Fintech in Western Europe in Wealth & Finance International
• Best Online Development in Goodacre Systems in the City
• Brandon Hall Group Excellence Awards
• Winner of Systems in the City Awards
• Private Banking & Wealth Management Germany Awards

International environments with offices in
• London
• Zurich
• Stuttgart
• Winchester
• Berne
• Singapore
• Vienna
• Barcelona
• Bubikon
• Puchheim

jobs_results.title: Front-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
• Oferta completada, siempre puedes dejarnos tus datos y te avisaremos la próxima vez ¿Estás aburrido de hacer mantenimientos de código y quieres un proyecto donde poder expresar todo tu arte?

Nuestro cliente, una «startup» con más de 100 trabajadores, busca un desarrollador muy concienciado por las buenas practicas en la parte de desarrollo, pero que también tenga un ojo puesto en el producto y que pueda ayudar al equipo de UX/UI a transformar todos los conceptos en realidades.
Un perfil analítico con una mentalidad centrada en el cliente y si tienes un enfoque «lean», será un plus.

Además, buscan que puedas centrarte en la entrega del producto, desde el concepto incial hasta su venta en el mercado.
Experiencia comprobada en trabajo en equipo ágil bajo Scrum, Kanban o Scrumban
Experiencia con React y Redux – Saga y componentes diseñados
Conocimiento de Webpack y Babel
Conocimiento de los paradigmas OOP y FP
Escribir código limpio y comprobable, pruebas unitarias, pruebas de... integración y pruebas de IU
Ojo crítico en UX / UI y capacidad de pensar en componentes reutilizables

¿Qué harás como Front-end Developer?

Desarrollarás diferentes proyectos web con un alto tráfico de usuarios, para ello trabajarás de la mano del equipo de producto y UX.

Onboarding:

Tu incorporación será muy bien recibida, alucinarás con el plan de nuevos trabajadores y te acompañarán en todo momento para que puedas desarrollar tu potencial.

Todo sobre ruedas:

Parece que todo va increíble, manejas el código a tus anchas y estás deseando aportar ideas y soluciones que mejoren el producto.

Nuevos horizontes:

Estarás completamente integrad@, habrás desarrollado nuevas funcionalidades y encarado los problemas que hayan surgido para hacer la aplicación lo mejor posible.

Ya habrás tendido la mano para resolver algún problema de código y estarás preparado para cualquier reto dentro de la organización.

¿Qué beneficios tendrás?
Ambiente profesional joven con muchas ganas de crear producto brutal.
Desarrollo profesional y posibilidad de asumir puestos de responsabilidad en función del desempeño de la empresa.
Café gratis y fruta fresca.
Salario atractivo y condiciones de bonificación basadas en objetivos.
Posibilidad de teletrabajo.

Trabajarás en un ambiente profesional joven, dinámico, multidisciplinario e internacional y es una gran oportunidad en un sector de alto crecimiento.
Además, tendrás la posibilidad de desarrollarte profesionalmente y asumir puestos de responsabilidad en función del desempeño de la empresa.
El salario es atractivo y con condiciones de bonificación basadas en objetivos.

¿Dónde y cuándo lo harás?
Plaza de Europa, Barcelona
De lunes a jueves de 9.00 a 18.00 y los viernes de 9:00 a 15:00
Nuestro cliente, valora el encaje cultural sobre la pericia técnica. Por lo que, con que tengas las skills principales y sobre todo muchas muchas ganas de aprender. Puedes ser el elegido
Envíanos un correo para conocerte y que formes parte de la comunidad Tadatic.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Front-end Software Engineer (Vuejs)
jobs_results.description:
Bounsel is an all-in-one contract management platform powered by AI and Big Data. Our mission is to make contracts more connected, more intelligent and more human.

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, passionate and experienced Back-end Software Engineer to join our tech team. In this role, you’ll play an important part in making our cool SaaS platform highly usable and thoroughly enjoyable by writing an incredible, clean and large-scalable front-end code.

This is an excellent opportunity for a curious software engineer who wants to create great features that will take our SaaS to the next level and who’s eager to join a dynamic, fast-growing startup that fosters a fun, transparent and results-oriented culture.

What you will do
• Develop user-centric apps and services using Vue.js, HTML5 and CSS3.
• Build modular and reusable components and libraries for a large and scalable app.
• Improve and optimize the application for rendering performance.
• Implement automated testing... integrated into development and maintenance workflows.
• Stay up-to-date with all recent developments in the Js/Ts and Vue.js space.
• Keep an eye on security updates and issues found with Vue.js and dependencies.
• Propose any upgrades and updates to keep up with modern security and development best practices.
• Work with infrastructure teams to build APIs using GraphQL.
• Support the product team in implementing user requirements.

Must have
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science.
• Proficient in English.
• Highly proficient with Typescript language, HTML5 and CSS3.
• Highly proficient with Vue.js framework and its core principles.
• Ability to write efficient, secure, well-documented and clean Javascript code with tests.
• Attention to detail and autonomy.

Nice to have
• Experience with Graphql.
• Knowledge in Python, SQL, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud-based providers (GCloud) or CI.
• International exposure and startup experience.
• UI/UX experience

jobs_results.title: Senior Front-End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Nuestro cliente está buscando un Programador Senior Front-end para unirse a su equipo y formar parte de un emocionante viaje en el mundo de la tecnología.

Nuestro cliente, líder en el sector hotelero y turístico, está buscando a una persona interesada en el desafío de unirse a una empresa multinacional con más de 220 ubicaciones y 5000 empleados.
Si eres un apasionado de la programación Front-end y estás listo para enfrentar desafíos emocionantes, este es el lugar adecuado para ti

Descripción del Trabajo:

Como Programador Senior Front-end, tendrás la oportunidad de contribuir al desarrollo de aplicaciones web de vanguardia que cautivan a los clientes y mejoran su experiencia en línea.
Tu experiencia en tecnologías Front-end será fundamental para el éxito de los proyectos.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web:

Colaborar en el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones web utilizando las últimas tecnologías Front-end... incluyendo React y Angular.

Server Side Rendering:
Implementar el rendering del lado del servidor (SSR) para mejorar el rendimiento y la eficiencia de las aplicaciones.

Gestión de Monorepos:
Trabajar en un entorno de monorepo para gestionar de manera eficiente el código fuente y las dependencias.

Programación en Typescript y Javascript:
Utilizar tus habilidades en Typescript y Javascript para escribir código limpio, eficiente y escalable.

Colaboración Interfuncional:

Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con otros equipos de desarrollo, diseñadores y expertos en UX/UI para garantizar la alineación de los proyectos con los objetivos comerciales y las necesidades de los usuarios.

Optimización de Rendimiento:
Identificar y solucionar problemas de rendimiento en aplicaciones web para garantizar una experiencia del usuario excepcional.

Mantenimiento y Resolución de Problemas:
Mantener y mejorar continuamente las aplicaciones existentes, así como abordar de manera proactiva los problemas técnicos.

Investigación Tecnológica:

Mantenerse al tanto de las tendencias y avances en el desarrollo Front-end y proponer nuevas tecnologías y enfoques cuando sea necesario.

Requisitos:
Experiencia comprobada en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web utilizando React y Angular.
Fuerte comprensión de Server Side Rendering.
Experiencia trabajando en entornos de Monorepo.
Conocimientos sólidos en Typescript y Javascript.
Habilidad para trabajar de manera efectiva en equipos multidisciplinarios.
Pasión por la innovación tecnológica y el aprendizaje continuo.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación en español y ingles.

Esperamos tu solicitud

Uno de nuestros objetivos como organización es asegurar un proceso de selección alineado con criterios de diversidad , equidad e inclusión por ello buscamos crear un panel de empleados diverso, equitativo e inclusivo, donde cada individuo sea valorado por su talento y potencial, sin importar su origen étnico, género, orientación sexual, religión o diversidad funcional.

Nos comprometemos a minimizar cualquier sesgo o barrera que pueda existir en el proceso de selección, para asegurar que todos los candidatos sean evaluados de manera justa y objetiva donde solo sea evaluado su capacidad para realizar la función, su potencial y su valores.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Front-end Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Devaway is a SW company in the province of Alicante, Spain. We're 20 software engineers and designers with years of experience working for world-class software companies, mostly based in the California area.

We specialize in working with entrepreneurs to turn concepts into working software as quickly as possible. If you join our team, you'll be working with fast-moving startups from all over the globe, including Silicon Valley, London, and Australia.

Our work-philosophy🧭

Love what you do, share what you know & enjoy with the team.

It is really important to us the quality of our work, but at the same time, have fun. We love to laugh, enjoy and help the team.

We are professionals that love what we do, but we want to enjoy life with our families, friends and hobbies at the same time. We understand that having time to conciliate your personal and professional life empower our work and team.

The challenge 🏆

We are looking for a SW Engineer Front End who is passionate about their... craft to join our engineering and product teams. You will solve challenging technical problems for our clients across the globe. You will contribute to Devaway engineering’s culture of technical excellence and will receive our mentorship. This is a great opportunity to join an amazing team working on international projects.

What is it like to work at Devaway?👩🏻‍💻

As we said, our goals are to deliver the maximum excellence projects having a good environment for the team. To accomplish that, we like to work with:
• Agile methodologies
• Incremental delivery
• CI/CD development flow (devops team mindset)
• Testing friendly
• Product first mindset
• Team working
• Remotely friendly
• Design and work with individual career plans

What do we need from you?🤔
• Develop new user facing features
• Write reusable code, components and libraries
• Enhance application for maximum speed and scalability
• Validate input before submitting to back end
• Collaborate with team members and stakeholders
• Bridge the gap between product designers and technical implementation
• Translate designs to actual code side by side with our engineers

What do we ask? 🤷‍♀️
• From 2 to 6 years of experience in a similar role
• Possess proficiency in Javascript and experience in React.
• Nice to have: Next.js, React Hooks and GraphQL
• Proficient in code versioning tools.
• Ability to work in a team and share knowledge with team members
• Passionate about having fun coding
• Good level of English, spoken and written.

What do we really like?😍
• Team players, we avoid rock stars and cowboys
• Empower each team member
• Be curious about new technologies, methodologies and ways to grow.
• Never stop learning
• Motivated and fun people
• Share our knowledge
• Flexible and willing to take on new opportunities

How will be your first days in Devaway?📅

First month: For the first few weeks we will make sure you know your impact on the team and the business, learning about the team, the business, and processes. You will focus on understanding the product and the code, a key success factor. Do not be afraid of the onboarding, we will do it bit by bit and according to your needs

First Quarter: Little by little, you will begin to have one-on-one with Managers and HR, who will take care of your professional and personal development. You will be integrated on a Team knowing the biz goals and adding value to the product. Also, you will understand the development flow and agile techniques applied to the product and team. If you have ideas to improve it, go ahead, share and test it!!!

To the moon: Devaway will challenge you to grow your impact on the company and as a professional. We will work to help you enjoy yourself at work, and will expect you to train and share your knowledge with others.

Now, you are able to lead a team, mastering tech, or whatever goal you have in mind, and you can use your superpower to create new products around the world. 🚀

What do we offer? 🎁

⏰Flexible work schedule

🏡Remote working 100% or open office🏢

🥘Restaurant card

🩺Medical insurance

💂🏻‍♀️English classes

📚Learning plan

🛤Career plan

🥐Food & drinks at the office☕

🎢Offsites/Teambuilding

What are the steps in the hiring process?🗺

If you have come this far, we are glad that you were interested in knowing us, and you are one step away from knowing us even more.

Apply for the job offer, and the HR Team will take a look at your CV. If your profile fits on Devaway, we will have a call to know you better, and we will tell you more about us and the job.

Our hiring process is focused on you, we want to know you and we want to give you information about us, so you can make sure if you could fit with the team, the values, the projects and the role. To do that, normally, we have 3 interviews and a technical test. The interviews will be; one with HR, one with a technical workmate and one with a manager. Feel free to ask them any question.

If everything goes well, the process will end with an offer letter, where we will talk about salaries, perks and incorporation dates.

Let us give you an advice; be yourself, is who we want to know.🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️
